A minimalist recipe card illustration for echinacea immune tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single hand-thrown ceramic cup filled with deep amber echinacea tea, placed slightly off-center (upper right). Scattered around the cup on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: two purple coneflower (echinacea) blossoms with pink-purple petals and rust-orange spiky centers, one cluster of dried echinacea root chips (warm tan), and two small leaves. The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text, no steam.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Coneflowers and root chips have confident silhouettes, NOT painterly. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. The cup has a subtle ember-orange glazed rim. Warm midday light from upper left casts a faint shadow below the cup. Feels protective, robust, cold-season-ready. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
